Thanks — quick product perspective after an initial look: we currently have two feasible approaches for Dedicated tenants:

Option A (Short dev work, safer): implement an "ephemeral CMK window" in orchestration that sets a lease (start/end) on a customer-supplied CMK. Keys are still provisioned in the customer's KMS but Redwood records a lease metadata field. This requires changes to the keystore metadata API and a small UI update. Audit logs already capture key usage but we'll need to tag those events with lease_id. Estimated: ~2 sprint of low-priority eng work (4–6 weeks) but we can produce a manual sample export earlier.

Option B (Immediate, manual): Engineering produces a one-off evidence pack by exporting raw audit records for the tenant and redacting internal-only fields. This is manual and requires security review but can be done in 48–72 hours for a small sample set.

Questions for Security: what exact log schema do we need to include in the CSV (see Neha's line below)? I can attach a diagram of Option A flow (proposed_keystore_flow.drawio).

-Marissa

I dug into the audit store. For Novamed's ask we must provide:

Required fields for CSV export (minimum):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- tenant_id (customer tenant guid)
- key_id (kms key resource id)
- action (Create|Rotate|Encrypt|Decrypt|Delete|Grant)
- principal (service-account / user id)
- request_id / trace_id
- caller_ip (if available)
- request_payload_digest (hash)

Additional required evidence for compliance review:
- access-control policy snapshot (policy version + effective date)
- key material ownership affirmation (doc or signed statement)
- retention policy config (where audit logs are stored, retention TTL)

Short answers:
- Manual sample export (Option B) is doable in ~48 hours if we limit to 5 tenant events and redact internal indices. I will generate retention_sample_accounts.csv and include 3 raw log snippets (as text).
- For a sanctioned ephemeral CMK (Option A) to be acceptable, engineering must surface lease_id in the audit events and we must keep immutable audit export for at least 90 days.

Risk note: we can't produce full production audit exports on demand without a legal/evidence approval. Irene, can Compliance sign off on a limited-scope export? If not, we'll need to route through Legal and that will delay the 72-hour target.

-Neha
Security Engineering Lead
